name: minex
description: Minex — 领域无关的驱动宿主内核（微内核架构）

scripts.build: npm run build -w @minex/kernel && npm run build -w minex-filesystem-driver && npm run build -w mist-session-driver && npm run build -w minex-appearance-driver  && npm run build -w minex-markdown-driver && npm run build -w @minex/cli && npm run build -w @minex/ui-shell
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @minex/kernel && npm run typecheck -w minex-filesystem-driver && npm run typecheck -w mist-session-driver && npm run typecheck -w minex-appearance-driver  && npm run typecheck -w minex-markdown-driver && npm run typecheck -w @minex/cli && npm run typecheck -w @minex/ui-shell
scripts.ui: npm run build -w @minex/kernel && npm run dev -w @minex/ui-shell
scripts.drivers:sync: npm run build -w minex-filesystem-driver -w minex-appearance-driver -w minex-markdown-driver && node scripts/sync-drivers.mjs
